frontend_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the frontend listener (e.g., 0.0.0.0, ::, or * for all interfaces).

frontend_port.description: Port number for the frontend TLS listener (commonly 443 for HTTPS).

upstreams.description: List of backend servers to proxy requests to (must contain at least one upstream).

name.description: Optional human-readable identifier for the upstream (used in comments).

host.description: IP address or hostname of the backend server.

port.description: Port number of the backend server (e.g., HTTP app port).

ciphers.description: Ordered list of allowed TLS ciphers (OpenSSL cipher string format).

prefer_server_ciphers.description: If enabled, prefer the server’s cipher order over the client’s. Recommended for stronger security.

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (set to 0 to auto-detect and use one per CPU core).

log_file.description: Path to the log file (e.g., /var/log/hitch/hitch.log). If empty, logs go to stdout/stderr.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of logs (debug = most verbose, err = least).

ssl_session_cache_enabled.description: Enable SSL session caching for improved handshake performance.

ssl_session_cache_size.description: Maximum number of SSL sessions to cache.

ocsp_responder_urls.description: List of OCSP responder URLs for stapling (if certificates support OCSP).

certificates.description: List of TLS certificates to load (required for TLS termination).

name.description: Optional name for the certificate (used in comments).

pem_path.description: Absolute path to the PEM file containing the certificate and private key.

sni_names.description: List of SNI hostnames this certificate serves (e.g., ['example.com', 'www.example.com']).

health_check_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between backend health checks (0 = disable health checks).

tcp_keepalive_enabled.description: Enable TCP keepalive on frontend connections (helps detect dead client connections).

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for active connections to drain during graceful shutdown.

use_system_tls_engine.description: Use the system-provided TLS engine (e.g., OpenSSL 3.0 providers) instead of built-in engine.
